No coincidence with an underived constant (e.g. 4/pi, bar-odd Q_beta) is claimed — numerology + entropy-bound guard. CONCLUSION: closing E_unit needs a NEW bar-even absolute scale ~0.996 MeV, unreachable from the anchors by one derived factor — Subgoal-2 (absolute scales), owner-gated. The hard wall is now localized to a single bar-even energy.
